name: Stonewatch
summary: Stonewatch is a fortified stronghold in central Redridge Mountains, built to defend the surrounding human lands from northern invasions. Formerly manned by Stormwind soldiers, the fortress has fallen under the brutal control of the Blackrock orcs, posing an immediate threat to nearby Lakeshire.

sections.title: A Bastion Overrun
sections.body: Positioned over the cliffs near Stonewatch Falls, Stonewatch comprises a heavily built tower and keep designed to guard the approaches from the Burning Steppes. Originally held by Lakeshire's defenders, the fortification fell when the rogue warlock Morganth forged an alliance with the Blackrock clan. Infused with dark magic, the invading orcs overwhelmed the local human garrison—the 12th Sabre Regiment—and claimed the fortress. Although Morganth eventually turned on his allies and withdrew to the nearby Tower of Ilgalar with an army of Shadowhide gnolls, the Blackrock orcs retained a stranglehold over the keep under the command of General Gath'Ilzogg and Lieutenant Tharil'zun.

sections.title: The Threat to Lakeshire
sections.body: With Stonewatch firmly garrisoned by hostile orcs, Lakeshire sits directly in the crosshairs of an impending conquest. Cut off from substantial military reinforcements by an indifferent or paralyzed Stormwind House of Nobles, Magistrate Solomon and Marshal Marris have been forced to hire mercenary aid and volunteers. Decapitating the fortress's leadership—targeting both Tharil'zun and Gath'Ilzogg—remains the town's desperate primary hope for relieving the siege on the region.

faq.answer: Stonewatch is occupied by the Blackrock clan of orcs, under the command of General Gath'Ilzogg and his lieutenant, Tharil'zun. They drove out the kingdom's garrison and now use the stronghold as a staging ground for attacks across Redridge.

faq.q: How did the humans lose Stonewatch?
faq.answer: The keep fell during a concerted invasion by the Blackrock clan, empowered by the dark sorcery of the rogue human warlock Morganth. Together, they crushed the defenders of the 12th Sabre Regiment and captured the entire complex.

faq.q: Why isn't Stormwind sending an army to take it back?
faq.answer: Stormwind has refused to allocate sufficient troops to the border regions, leaving Magistrate Solomon and Marshal Marris to defend Redridge alone. Lakeshire relies on visiting adventurers and mercenaries to mount counterattacks against Stonewatch.

faq.q: What is the relationship between Stonewatch and the Tower of Ilgalar?
faq.answer: Morganth originally aided the Blackrock orcs in taking Stonewatch, but shortly after their victory, he betrayed his allies. He constructed the nearby Tower of Ilgalar to amass his own retinue of magical thralls and Shadowhide gnolls, attacking orc and human alike.

angles.text: Stonewatch represents one of the most perilous forward incursions of hostile orcs into core Alliance territory, making its recovery vital to the safety of Redridge.
The slaughter of the 12th Sabre Regiment and the fall of the keep stand as painful reminders of Lakeshire's vulnerability and Stormwind's political neglect.
